messages.subject: scatterplot with continuous colour scale
parts:
I want to produce a scatter plot of x,y,z, where the colour of the point is determined by z on a continuous colour scale.  There is a ggplot2 web help page which outlines how to do this, i.e. http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/scale_gradient.html .  By running the example code,
dsub <- subset(diamonds, x > 5 & x < 6 & y > 5 & y < 6)
(d <- qplot(x, y, data=dsub, colour=z))
I get the following graph (i.e. discrete colours, which is different from the example given on the web page):

My understanding was that scale_colour_gradient() or one of it's variants should force a continuous colour scale, however I can not achieve this.

Am I missing something obvious?

Thanks in advance for your time,
Phil.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: scatterplot with continuous colour scale
parts:
Which version of ggplot2 are you using? The default guide for continuous color scales changed to colorbars in 0.9.2. I got the result on the help page using the current CRAN version 0.9.2.1 

Dennis
